title: Diffusion-Based Hypothesis Testing and Change-Point Detection
abstract: arXiv:2506.16089v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Score-based methods have recently seen increasing popularity in modeling and generation. Methods have been constructed to perform hypothesis testing and change-point detection with score functions, but these methods are in general not as powerful as their likelihood-based peers. Recent works consider generalizing the score-based Fisher divergence into a diffusion-divergence by transforming score functions via multiplication with a matrix-valued function or a weight matrix. In this paper, we extend the score-based hypothesis test and change-point detection stopping rule into their diffusion-based analogs. Additionally, we theoretically quantify the performance of these diffusion-based algorithms and study scenarios where optimal performance is achievable. We propose a method of numerically optimizing the weight matrix and present numerical simulations to illustrate the advantages of diffusion-based algorithms.

translated_title: 基于扩散的假设检验与变点检测
translated_abstract: 基于分数的方法近年来在建模与生成领域日益流行。已有研究构建了利用分数函数进行假设检验和变点检测的方法，但这些方法通常不如基于似然的方法强大。近期的工作考虑通过将分数函数与矩阵值函数或权重矩阵相乘进行变换，将基于分数的Fisher散度推广为扩散散度。在本文中，我们将基于分数的假设检验方法和变点检测停止规则扩展为基于扩散的对应方法。此外，我们从理论上量化了这些基于扩散的算法的性能，并研究了可实现最优性能的场景。我们提出了一种数值优化权重矩阵的方法，并通过数值模拟展示了基于扩散算法的优势。
tldr: 本文将基于分数的假设检验与变点检测方法推广为基于扩散的版本，通过数值优化权重矩阵提升检测能力，并从理论上量化了算法性能及其达到最优的条件。
en_tdlr: This paper extends score-based hypothesis testing and change-point detection to diffusion-based analogs with numerically optimized weight matrices, theoretically quantifying their performance and identifying conditions for achieving optimality.
